import.title: Import staff
import.intro: Upload a CSV or Excel file, match the columns, check, and import.
import.noCompanies: There is no company yet that you can add data to.
import.fileHint: The first row must be the column headers. Up to {max} rows.
import.readError: Could not read the file. Make sure it is a CSV or .xlsx.
import.tooManyRows: The file has {count} rows; the maximum is {max}. Split it into several files.
import.mapIntro: We guessed what each column means. Check and correct if needed.
import.duplicateTarget: “{field}” is selected for more than one column.
import.validRows: {count, plural, one {# row ready to import} other {# rows ready to import}}
import.errorRows: {count, plural, one {# row with errors will be skipped} other {# rows with errors will be skipped}}
import.skippedDuplicates: {count, plural, one {# duplicate skipped (already exists)} other {# duplicates skipped (already exist)}}
import.skippedErrors: {count, plural, one {# row skipped because of errors} other {# rows skipped because of errors}}
import.findings: {count, plural, =0 {No open issues} one {# open issue found} other {# open issues found}}
import.rulesFailed: The data is saved, but the rule check failed. It will run in the nightly check.

commitError.forbidden: You don’t have permission to add data to this company.
commitError.invalid: The data failed validation. Please upload the file again.
commitError.nothing: There are no new rows to import.
commitError.failed: The import failed and nothing was saved. Please try again.
commitError.partial: The import failed and could not be fully undone: some employees may have been saved without a contract. Check the company page.

error.endDateOnIndefinite: An indefinite contract cannot have an end date
error.fixedTermWithoutEnd: A fixed-term contract needs an end date

import.dupHint: Duplicates (same employee ID, or same name and birth date) are checked on import and skipped. Name-only matches are imported and flagged.
import.possibleDuplicates: {count, plural, one {# possible duplicate} other {# possible duplicates}}
import.possibleDuplicatesHint: These employees were imported, but someone with the same name already exists and there is no employee ID or birth date to tell them apart. Check them and delete any real duplicate.
